# region selector

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:regionSelector`](gmeow-regionSelector.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/regionSelector>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The selector that describes this region's boundaries. Functional per region: one selector per [`ImageRegion`](../classes/gmeow-ImageRegion.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ImageRegion`](../classes/gmeow-ImageRegion.md) -> [`gmeow:RegionSelector`](../classes/gmeow-RegionSelector.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:regionSelector`](gmeow-regionSelector.md) from [`gmeow:ImageRegion`](../classes/gmeow-ImageRegion.md) to [`gmeow:RegionSelector`](../classes/gmeow-RegionSelector.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

    gmeow:regionLabel    "Dana" ;
    gmeow:regionSelector ex:bbox .
